* '''Mission''': [[File:GTA San Andreas radar Triads.png]][[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas/Yay Ka-Boom-Boom|Yay Ka-Boom-Boom]]
* '''Location''': [[File:GTA San Andreas radar Mystery.png]]Mystery caller's ranch, Tierra Robada

After the cutscenes, get into the monster truck. Now you must complete a timed checkpoint race in six and a half minutes, which begins as soon as you pass through the first checkpoint.  Instead of a handbrake, this vehicle has four-wheel steering.  So use the same button you would to brake to make extra sharp turns.

== Rewards ==
Cash rewards are based on your time of completion.
* 4:20 = $5,000
* 5:00 = $4,000
* 5:30 = $3,000
* 6:00 = $2,000
* 6:30 = $1,000

== Tips ==
Use the dirt road to the left of the truck as you face forward to gain some speed before you hit the first beacon.  This should give a few seconds.
